clarifications.reasonOrder: The order of contracts/v1.json reasonCodes is canonical; sorted-unique-reason-array means unique values in that declared order, not lexical order.
clarifications.conflictingReceiptIds: Two evidence objects with one receiptId but different canonical bytes are schema_invalid and suppress.
clarifications.externalWriteWithoutRollback: Because v1 has no rollback-proof field, any evidence sideEffectClass of external-write produces external_write_without_rollback and suppresses.
